svg.title: Goulds 3×4-10 pump at 3550 rpm: impeller choice
svg.text: Goulds 3×4-10 pump at 3550 rpm: impeller choice
NPSH required: dashed (ft); brake horsepower: dash-dot
At 350 gal/min go up: the 8-in curve gives ≈ 255 ft (< 300 ft) and the 9-in curve ≈ 335 ft (> 300 ft) → use the 9-in impeller
(solution readings; the redrawn curves give ≈ 237 and ≈ 323 ft — the choice is the same).
At the 9-in point read η ≈ 62% (between the 60 and 65% lines), NPSH required ≈ 12 ft (between 10 and 15 ft), ≈ 48 bhp.
Redrawn from Foust Fig. 21.17b (Goulds Pumps; digitized from the paper's copy,
approximate efficiency, NPSH and bhp lines); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
